reviewLead.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness 复核这些会话

20 个长会话候选仍待结果复核

## 先核对的会话

- S1：子 Agent 候选，估算活跃约 706.1 分钟，失败事件 0 次
- S2：子 Agent 候选，估算活跃约 512.7 分钟，失败事件 0 次
- S3：用户会话候选，估算活跃约 451.4 分钟，失败事件 0 次
- S4：子 Agent 候选，估算活跃约 389.7 分钟，失败事件 0 次
- 当前展示 20 个未复核活跃长会话中的 4 个；其余 16 个继续通过同一个有界 review packet 复核。

## 先做什么

在操作系统临时目录创建 <run>，从项目根运行：

```bash
node scripts/session-analysis.mjs insights --platform qoder --workspace . --selection all-eligible --limit 1000 --format json --output <run>/insights.json
node scripts/session-analysis/usage-review-packet.mjs --source <run>/insights.json --workspace . --limit 8 --output <run>/.review-packet.json
```

私有 review packet 会在本地解析候选；只为 S1, S2, S3, S4 写入 taskFamily、outcome、friction、confidence 和 evidenceReason。先完成复核，不改业务代码，也不创建 Memory、Skill 或 Hook。

## 我们看到了什么

187 个已分析会话中有 20 个（10.7%）超过估算活跃时长阈值，最长估算为 706.1 分钟，其中 0 个已有结果复核；另有 2 个长跨度可能来自空闲或恢复。这只是调查线索，尚未确认存在效率、任务拆分、工具链或模型问题。

## 为什么值得复核

未复核前无法区分复杂任务、工具链摩擦、暂停恢复噪音或正常的长任务。

## 预期结果

每个展示候选都完成任务族、结果和摩擦分类，让报告能够判断是否真的需要改进。

## 范围

只生成隐私安全的会话效率复核和 reader report，不改业务代码，不把墙钟跨度当作活跃成本。持久报告只保留匿名别名；私有 review packet 不得复制进报告。这是 4/20 的有界视图（4/N）；只对展示样本下结论，其余候选保持未复核。

## 怎样算完成

<run>/.review.json 对 S1, S2, S3, S4 各有一条有效复核；语义复核生成 <run>/insights.reviewed.json；<run>/report.md 以 reviewed source 校验通过。复核未确认问题时，不创建优化项。

## 验证

- 运行 `node scripts/session-analysis/usage-semantic-review.mjs --source <run>/insights.json --packet <run>/.review-packet.json --review <run>/.review.json --output <run>/insights.reviewed.json`
- 运行 `node scripts/session-analysis/validate-usage-report.mjs --source <run>/insights.reviewed.json --report <run>/report.md`，必须返回 `ok: true`
- 确认 reviewed source 的 `outcomeReview.reviewedActiveLongCount` 等于已复核的展示别名数；通过后删除两个私有临时 review 文件

findings.title: Edits go unverified because no validation command runs after changes
findings.reason: In 40 analyzed sessions, 330 edit events were observed with zero subsequent validation commands. Population coverage shows 0 of 186 sessions contained any check. The diagnostic flag 'no-reviewed-relevant-check-evidence' is present. The project has available validation commands (pnpm typecheck, pnpm build) but they are never invoked after edits. The sole candidate with actual code changes (1 edit, 1 file) closed as 'changed-without-check'. Zero project-level Hooks exist to trigger validation automatically. This means changes may introduce undetected regressions and the user is the sole validation mechanism.

findings.title: Agent lacks scoped project instructions for a 42-source-file codebase

findings.title: Task completion cannot be confirmed at any acceptance boundary
findings.reason: Population coverage shows 0 of 186 sessions with structured completion signals and 0 with user correction signals. The project profile shows no recovery evidence, and 0 of 287 task episodes were recovered. In case of a bad change, the operator has no documented path to restore service.

findings.title: Duplicate Memory title creates retrieval ambiguity
findings.reason: Asset integrity review found 1 exact title collision: two project-scope Memory entries share the same normalized title. The review covered all 112 Memory titles without truncation. The integrity finding is advisory and explicitly states the collision proves only title metadata naming collision, not body duplication or current impact. However, exact same-scope title collisions can cause retrieval to return conflicting entries, and the quality gates require an ordinary Low governance finding for exact collisions. A separate similarity candidate (80% title match) was found but remains deferred per quality gate policy on near matches.
